harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-24 in borg-zoo#784, before any result was read. Three arms on track-p d68c1407: ctl (loop_breaker 0, C's play),
net3 (the shipped net: breaker 1, 16 moves, 3 grids) and net4 (the arm #1189's four-grid DL1 cycle would have needed:
breaker 1, 16 moves, 4 grids). Pilot, then the ladder classes-1800 starts 1-360 (verysmall, small-rest, medium) on the
pilot's gate; big and full on the owner's word.
Gate: no config_error; one binary; each arm's loop_breaker/loop_moves/loop_grids in params-core.json; every cell ends in
death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; stalls and wall timeouts apart. Report per arm against ctl: deaths and causes (exact
McNemar), stuck games (borg-zoo#732's flag) as the primary endpoint — net4 must not have more stuck games than net3; loops
detected per game from the "# Loop detected" notes, with the decision pairs of the notes tabulated (each pair stays worth a
source fix of its own); the false-positive probe: every break whose window actually contained productive play (map learning,
danger, the mixed walk's branch returns, committed stair walks), read from the traces. Descriptive CL/depth/deaths per arm;
no improvement claim without the prespecified margins (RULES 14).
